name: Balance the equation
description: Balance a chemical equation with coefficient steppers and a live atom tally. The grader parses the formulas itself: smallest whole numbers is full credit, balanced but not reduced is partial.

fields.name: reactants
fields.description: Formulas on the left, e.g. C3H8, O2. Parentheses are fine: Ca(OH)2, Al2(SO4)3.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Optional context shown above the equation.
